assumptions.first_fill: A non-full tank is first filled at the cheapest station within 25 miles of the start (the nearest within 100 miles if none).
assumptions.small_stops: Top-ups under 5 gallons move to the previous or next stop when feasible; the extra cost is reported as merge_extra_cost_usd.
assumptions.station_locations: Station positions are their city's coordinates (the price file has no coordinates).
assumptions.prices: Retail prices from the supplied CSV.
